latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the webtorrent skill providing streaming BitTorrent client features for Node.js and browsers.

- Supports torrent downloading, seeding, magnet links, and media streaming.
- Works in both Node.js (TCP/UDP) and browser (WebRTC Data Channel) environments.
- Exposes a simple API for adding, seeding, and managing torrents and files.
- Includes core usage examples for Node.js and browsers, plus CLI tool instructions.
- Offers options for torrent selection, storage strategy, bandwidth limits, and media playback integration.
